card.architecture: DeflickerAuto node (PixelHarness) — LoadVideo → GetVideoComponents → DeflickerAuto → SaveAnimatedWEBP(lossless). Per frame: BiRefNet matte, character stats (luma P5/P15 dark tail, chroma P90), whole-clip median±K·MAD outlier flagging, drift-weighted per-channel CDF match of flagged frames to the clean pool.
card.summary: Automatically detects and corrects flicker/washed-out frames in an AI-generated clip. Mattes each frame with BiRefNet, measures pose- and drift-invariant character statistics, flags frames that deviate from the whole-clip median (a wash is a chroma collapse), and re-histograms each flagged frame to the temporally-weighted clean frames. If nothing is defective the clip passes through untouched. No checkpoint — the node loads its own BiRefNet.
use_cases: fix a washed-out or flickering frame in a WAN/i2v sprite clip before pixelization
normalize per-frame tone/saturation drift outliers in an animation clip
card.pick_when: You have a clip with occasional bad (washed/flickering) frames and want them auto-corrected against the good frames.
